description: Known, accepted desktop/wasm divergences. Every entry must name the chain, the compared field, a reason and an issue. The comparison test fails on any mismatch not covered here and also fails when an entry no longer matches a real mismatch, so the list can only shrink.

entries.reason: The desktop chain descriptor selects TON wallet v4R2 (crates/rotor-core/src/chain.rs); the wasm derive_report selects W5 (crates/rotor-wasm/src/derive.rs). P0 records both outputs; P1 exposes both encodings explicitly through TonWalletVersion and the product decision is separate.
